channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: Makita debuts 40V max XGT Brushless 20-inch chain saw
item.description: The GCU08 is Makita’s most powerful cordless chainsaw.

item.title: Greenworks supplies World Ice Art team with contest's first battery-powered tools
item.description: The Multi Block Competition challenges teams of four artists to transform nine massive blocks of ice into monumental sculptures over six days.

item.title: Loftness names McComas as chief operating officer
item.description: Since joining Loftness in 2024, Shannon McComas most recently served as vice president of sales & marketing.

item.title: NC State uses holiday cheer to fund upcoming trip to NCLC
item.description: The students harvested grapevine and fresh greenery directly from the university’s field lab to make unique wreaths and seasonal decorations.

item.title: MVLA names Kavalier as garden, landscapes director at George Washington’s Mount Vernon
item.description: In this role, Kavalier will lead the preservation, restoration, and long-term stewardship of the estate’s historic gardens.

item.title: Little League International names Willoughby as landscaping, sports turf technician
item.description: Trinity Willoughby previously served as a summer intern for the program before earning the full-time role.

item.title: Black-owned, woman-led landscaping business in Indianapolis earns Gusto Impact Award
item.description: Greene Thumb Landscape hires employees that often face barriers to employment.

item.title: EarthaPro adds chemical tracker, automatic monthly invoicing and integrated routing
item.description: These updates address three areas for applicators: regulatory compliance, cash flow stability and route efficiency.

item.title: SePro set for March 18 webinar on landscaping with less labor
item.description: The live webinar, "Create Beautiful Landscapes with Less Labor," will focus on reducing trimming cycles, preventing pest outbreaks and maintaining more consistent landscapes.

item.title: Stay Green acquires JH O'Brien in California
item.description: An additional 40 team members will join the Stay Green team.
